title: The McKinsey partner who hosted the episode — 'a bold thinker always pushing on frontier topics'
summary: Davies is a senior partner at McKinsey and global leader of its capital markets work, and he hosted the Inside the Strategy Room episode. He lists what they covered, including civic infrastructure as a horizon for entrepreneurship and the LTSE.
blockquote: Thank you Eric for the terrific conversation, and for being a bold thinker always pushing on frontier topics!
attribution_title: Senior Partner and Global Leader of Capital Markets, McKinsey & Company
